title: Face Wall Generator
subtitle: Repeatable grids for checking face detectors
description: Tile a folder of face pictures into a seeded grid. Optionally crop faces with OpenCV’s YuNet detector before building the wall.
longDescription: A pip-installable Python CLI for building test images with known face counts and grid positions. Seeded selection makes layouts repeatable; optional YuNet face cropping prepares ordinary photos first. The repository includes public-domain portrait samples.
features: Seeded layouts with configurable rows and columns
results: Repeatable test grids with known face positions
